label: Rational authorship and epistemic ends in contingent creation
summary: Proposed unreviewed philosophical checkpoint at main 8083301a037428574d0e46b1064d8f6d858da377. Reuses #742 base-fixed net selection, #545/#555 necessitation and reason-closure boundaries, #1875 necessary bearer/contingent output and omission controls, #1380 knowledge discrimination, #737 and #1410 veracity boundaries. Distinguishes productive actual explanation, partial contrastive reasons and exhaustive determining reasons at the same whole-order explanandum. Practical authorship candidate: apprehended end, adoption for an actual reason, and intention-directed production distinguish purposive realization from post-hoc labeling and controlled lottery policy without necessarily explaining the exact endorsement contrast. Counterexample to treating the personal label as sufficient: an uncontrolled random selector within a reason-constrained policy. The same productive standard credits an impersonal producer; its modal/causal stability is compatible with reliable evidence. Normative candidate: deliberate systematic frustration of a conferred truth-directed epistemic capacity, without overriding justification, is contrary to faithfully realizing that specific end. Requires domain, normal use, genuine cognition and goodness; assertion truthfulness is not a trace-reliability theorem. No modal collapse or skepticism inferred from mere source contingency, and no actual divine application established. C2 concerns absence of n, not absence of distinct created effects. Note: docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#rational-authorship-versus-brute-selection-2026-11-23-proposed-unreviewed. No new theorem, statement, definition, sourced claim, or support edge. Existing full-synthesis underdetermination retained; author-side semantic sweep only. Continuation (same date, proposed): docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md#can-direct-intentional-production-be-extrinsic-without-becoming-brute-2026-11-23-proposed-unreviewed. Read ST I q.19 a.5 and q.45 a.3/q.13 a.7 alongside q.14 a.8–9,11 and the prior #462 O'Connor/Huneeus comparison. Distinguish one-act rational order of willed means and ends from the causing of a separate act of willing. Test coarse intention versus content-specific production and merely permitted consequences. Rejected shortcut: success-defined productive relation entails the effect trivially, which does not demonstrate nontrivial efficacy of a specific intention. Compare A: a particular agent-directed productive transaction, not a separately caused executive state; B: specific content-adoption with independently intelligible intentional object and an explanatory role prior to realization, not an outcome-copying label. A can conditionally cover concrete existential dependence without settling the fact-level transaction's obtaining; B needs an account of contingent nonintrinsic adoption consistent with strict simplicity. The strong intrinsic difference principle is an additional premise, not entailed by the weak difference of the whole transaction or by absence of passive change. Productive self-knowledge needs actual direction/reference, not mere possibility knowledge or causal scope. Conditional no-mediator regress applies only to recursively demanded separate voluntary mediators; no proof of metaphysical possibility or full agency. The earlier underdetermination judgment remains; no new source binding or formal edge.
blocker: OPEN: constitutive intentional reference and actual productive direction at the same simple necessary source without a world-label selector or contingent intrinsic modifier; scope of determining closure at contingent endorsement; nonvacuous normative limits on creative choices and absence of overriding reasons for systematic misleading evidence; actual evidence provenance and agent access. Need independent final semantic challenge, canonical related/dossier/novelty and offline validation, computed frontier-diff. No premise discharge claimed. Narrowed test: can source-level directed production under a contrast-discriminating description be genuine without an independently existing intrinsic executive selection-state? Determine whether the content-adoption distinction is explanatorily substantive, compatible with the q.45 creature-side relation reading, and adequate for efficacy and #1380's particular knowledge; otherwise assess which intrinsic simplicity commitment must be weakened. Scope note §§6–10; final independent challenge pending.
